test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The given bar chart shows average expenditure on food, rent, clothes and movies by individuals in a month in 4 different cities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a8e6c42594abdd842d157eff7a05927eebdfbe40858c662010c88addcc57af0.png] 

In which city is the expenditure on movies nearest to the average expenditure on movies across all four cities?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a8e6c42594abdd842d157eff7a05927eebdfbe40858c662010c88addcc57af0.png] 

**Concept Used:**

Average = (Total sum of values)/(Total number of values)

**Calculation:**

Total expenditure from all four cities on movies

⇒ 1520 + 2550 + 2050 + 2000 = 8,120

Average expenditure on movies across all four cities = (8120)/(4)=2030

Expenditure from Chennai city on movies = Rs 2,050

**Therefore, the city in which expenditure on movies is nearest to the average expenditure on movies across all four cities is Chennai.**
